confirmed_decisions.decision: Research disposition is executed: the reading view markup, styles, renderers, every repository gate and a live Edge baseline at 1280x900 and 2560x1080 were read first-hand.

Planning Readiness is Ready. The anchors exposure was measured by cited target line before any edit was designed, and it set the edit strategy: strict in-place edits in the two citation-dense files, additions at the end of the stylesheet.
Plan critique executed exactly once, before any source was touched. Nine findings CR-001 through CR-009.

Critique verdict: CR-001, CR-002, CR-003, CR-006 and CR-007 applied directly to the plan; CR-004 and CR-005 accepted as designed and recorded; CR-008 and CR-009 rejected on evidence. No finding required a user decision and none conflicts with a confirmed decision.

Implementation complete across P01 through P06, with two unplanned corrections the change forced: a derived count in the governance record and a sentence in a released changelog entry that this change falsified.
Review executed exactly once after implementation, against the full staged boundary, the measured before-and-after figures, four rendering modes and the final gate set.
Review outcome is Conformant. No defect and no routed finding. Three observations recorded as accepted design, two of them the standing CR-004 and CR-005 dispositions.

next_action.action: Commit the change and open the pull request. No routed finding is outstanding, so the next task is a new user selection rather than continued work on MRT-003.
